Class NamedType

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.Observable
      • hec.lang.NamedType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.lang.Comparable, java.util.Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AbstractConditionalBlockRef, AbstractDataObject, AbstractTSRecord, AdjustableParameter, BaseAltGlobalData, BaseGlobalVariable, CapacityOutage, CapacitySchedule, Conditional, ConditionalBlock, Controller, DefaultDataList, Element, Identifier, Manager, Node, OpControllableElement, OpControllableObject, OpControllerZones, OpRuleRef, OpSetRef, OpSupportConfig, OpSupportModelVariable, OpSupportTabConfig, PowerPlant, Pump, ReleaseAllocationSet, ReportInterval, ResSystemOpSet, RssOutput, RssTSLocationObject, SchedulableJob, ScriptGroup, ScriptIdentifier, StorageZone, StorageZoneRules, StreamElement, StreamJunction, StreamNode, SystemOpController, SystemOpRule, SystemOpRuleRef, SystemReservoirStorage, SystemStorageZone, TsVariant, UnitsType, UnmodifiableDataList, UnmodifiableDataObject, UserInfo, UserLoginInfo, WatershedLocation, ZoneBounds

    public abstract class NamedType
extends java.util.Observable
implements java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, AsciiSerializable, java.util.Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable, java.lang.Comparable
    NamedType serves as a superclass for Objects that need a name and description. Extends java.util.Observable so that any of the derived objects from NamedType (ie hec.io.Manager) can register observers.
    Author:
    John F. DeGeorge, Peter S. Morris, Shannon J. Newbold
